manualReproduction: Open tools/browser-check.html in a desktop browser with WebGL enabled. No local server or network dependencies are required.
Wait for the header status to show 12/12 loaded and rendered. Inspect the full gallery.
Read the visible JSON in #qa-report for exact hashes, materials, decoded texture dimensions, meshes, bounds, triangles, WebGL errors and frame pixel checks.
Use the optional contact-sheet download link to save the browser-rendered PNG.
